text:
ravi: FYI — last night around 01:20 UTC euw1 dipped into near-OOM territory for the dedicated pool. Triggered by a routing fallback from usw2 after a short network flake. We recovered but saw throttling and increased p99 by ~450ms. Filing quick notes + ask for followups.

maria: Ack. any idea on the blast radius? single customer, or across many routes?

evan: Looks like multiple routes. Initial spike = 4 routes that normally prefer euw1, then fallback to euw2 and finally to euw1 dedicated pool? bit messy.

olivia: To confirm: the fallback path was set to prefer cheaper region first, then nearest. That policy got triggered when usw2 reported transient packet loss.

kevin: From infra logs: autoscaler delayed scale-up due to cooldown + instance quota check. We saw 30s where new instances were queued but not provisioned. Logs: `scale-request id=abc123 coldstart_wait=30 quota_check=blocked`

infra-bot: autoscaler: scale-up event accepted for pool=dedicated-euw1 count+4 at 2026-03-18T01:21:09Z; provisioner: 3/4 started, 1 failed (az quota).

ravi: Important numbers: peak GPU usage hit 92% across the pool, KV cache pressure increased causing longer decode times; GPU hours burned extra ~2.6 GPU-hours due to inefficient fallbacks.

maria: Was there any model-level eviction or OOM kill?

evan: No OOM kills in kernel logs, but one worker logged `CUDA out-of-memory` inside the process for smaller-batch jobs — they retried & increased batch backoff. That contributed to the throttle tail.

olivia: Where forecasting broke down: the demand curve showed a short spike (10–12% above predicted) but our routing decision amplified it by redistributing to a constrained pool. Forecast alone didn't predict routing policy interactions.

kevin: Cost note: because fallback sent traffic cross-region, network egress + warmup caused an extra ~$420 in hourly spend for that window (est). Not huge but non-trivial if repeated.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigations we executed: 1) disabled cheaper-first fallback for eu traffic 2) bumped reserved headroom from 8% to 12% for dedicated-euw1 3) temporarily relaxed autoscaler cooldown to allow faster scale-up.

ravi: Lessons/asks: - routing policies should consider real-time pool headroom, not just static preferences. - autoscaler must surface quota-check failures faster (alert on blocked provisioners). - forecast inputs: include multi-region fallback probability in the demand model.

maria: Agreed. Also recommend adding a synthetic pre-warm for cross-region fallbacks: if a route starts sending fallback traffic, spin one small instance immediately (pre-warm) before full scale-up.

evan: Quick followups I can take: 1) add alert when provisioner reports quota_block > 0 for >10s 2) instrument fallback events count per route (we have partial logs, need aggregate)

olivia: I'll work with forecasting to add a feature: 'fallback amplification factor' — estimate multiplier on predicted demand when fallback probability > X. That should shift capacity targets.

kevin: Ops tasks: request AZ quota bump for euw1 from cloud provider, and add a mitigation doc for fallback storms (runbook).

ravi: Long-term: consider routing cost weighting + headroom constraints so cheaper-first never routes into <15% free GPU headroom. Also revisit reserved capacity SLAs per customer tier.

maria: Anything blocking these actions? Evictions: none. Quota request in progress (kevin). I can draft the runbook and pre-warm playbook.

sre-oncall: I'll keep the alerts we added for 48h and then hand to eng-sre. Recommend a retro on Monday to capture root cause tracebacks and update runbook.

infra-bot: deploy: alerting-rule `provisioner_blocked_alert` created in prod (id=rule-789) by evan at 2026-03-18T03:05:12Z

ravi: Thanks all. I'll capture action items: 1) quota request (kevin) 2) alerting (evan) 3) forecasting change (olivia) 4) runbook + pre-warm (maria) 5) routing policy change to respect headroom (eng-routing). Will schedule retro. :thumbsup: 

maria: +1. Save meeting notes and paste them here after retro.

kevin: Filed cloud quota ticket #CK-4421 — ETA 2 business days.

evan: PR for alert merged -> infra:master (refs: #567).

olivia: Forecasting feature ticket created: FG-212.

sre-oncall: Closing this thread for now. If we see recurrence, re-open and escalate.

ravi: Closing — thanks everyone.
